target: local-first desktop career harness and retained web workflow

automated_cases.notes: One of the six opt-in native cases was separately attempted with real Qwen. Its latest stricter quality run failed and is not counted among default-suite passes.

built_ui.harness_journey: source, save, reviewed import, PDF, inspected form, exact answer review, approval, submit, changed-posting recovery and reload without duplicate; Tauri IPC and network/application dependencies simulated

findings.title: Initial workspace read failure could expose an empty editable career book
findings.origin: code review plus fault-injected recovery regression
findings.expected: Preserve existing data and block editing after failed startup read.
findings.observed: The new failed-load view blocks editing; no save command is sent in the built UI fault injection.

findings.title: Local Qwen cold-start timeout and uneven generated wording
findings.expected: A bounded medium-model draft should complete reliably and stay within supplied facts.
findings.observed: Two runs hit the 30-second provider header limit. With a 120-second header allowance, one run completed in 112.63s and resisted injected Stanford/doctor claims, but overstated the supplied skill as expert. The stricter no-expertise-inflation follow-up timed out at 180s. Prompt and bounded timing were improved; reliable live-model quality is not established.

findings.title: Mac DMG-only build removed the app bundle before resource verification
findings.expected: Verifier can inspect the actual packaged worker and browser code.
findings.observed: Tauri cleaned the intermediate app after producing the DMG. Requesting app,dmg retains it. Apple Silicon replacement build passes resource checks. Intel also passed build, verification, worker and upload steps; final source rebuild remains required.

findings.title: Known advisories in retained Prisma/mobile dependency tree
findings.expected: Release tree has reviewed and resolved high-severity dependency advisories.
findings.observed: Production workspace audit reports three high and one moderate advisory. No exploitability claim is made; native desktop dependency reachability differs from the retained Prisma/mobile tree. Major dependency overrides were not forced without compatibility qualification.

findings.title: Long application histories exceeded the native transport limit
findings.origin: controlled temporary-SQLite reproduction followed by regression
findings.expected: A hundred saved applications should remain inspectable without exceeding the 4 MB native response limit or repeating every answer in history.
findings.observed: The pre-fix test produced a 6,059,443-character snapshot from 100 records with six 10,000-character answers each. History now returns summaries; the same regression passes below 200,000 characters and verifies full answers remain in storage. Exact review responses are unchanged.
evidence: scripts/qa/native-engine-browser.py background history and full-review journey

Not a pass percentage, security certification, reliability probability or hiring-success estimate. Passing deterministic flows establish a useful developer alpha, while live execution, operations and distribution remain gates.
